# Haus of Estate

> Haus of Estate is an international property introduction service for buyers, sellers, landlords and investors. We introduce enquirers to local estate agents in Dubai (UAE), the United Kingdom, Bali (Indonesia) and Cyprus. Enquiries are free to the enquirer.

## What we do and do not do

- We introduce enquirers to local estate agents, brokers and developers who hold the registrations their market requires, and we route enquiries to them.
- We are not a party to any purchase, sale or tenancy, and we do not give legal, tax or financial advice.
- We also provide property services such as property management, staging, furnishing and renovations.
- Property pages on this site feature homes in partner communities. Availability, pricing and terms are confirmed by the local agent, not by this site.
